newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel destroys three East Jerusalem Arab homes.
newsitem.headline: Israel destroys three East Jerusalem Arab homes.

text.p: Municipality workers tore down three illegally built homes in Arab East Jerusalem on Monday, the municipality said.
"After issuing several warnings...the municipality of Jerusalem had no option but to remove this morning three unauthorised buildings," a statement said.
It said two of the houses were in the Isawiya neighbourhood and one in Shuafat refugee camp.
A spokeswoman said one stood in an area designated for a school. Another was built on "public land" in Shuafat. A third house was built outside Isawiya's town plan.
"It's in a dangerous ravine," the spokeswoman said.
Mahmoud Sabbah al-Karshan said he built his now-flattened two-storey house in Shuafat on the ruins of his old home after it burned down when an adjacent gas station exploded.
He said he hired a lawyer to apply for a permit but it was denied. "We are a 40-member family and we were supposed to move into the new house next month. The house is complete," Karshan said.
"I continued the building because where else would I go?"

The municipality says Arabs have built more than 1,000 structures without permits this year, and Jerusalem Mayor Ehud Olmert has called illegal Arab building a "cancer" that threatens Israel's sovereignty in the holy city.
Palestinians say they are forced to build illegally because the municipality will not give them permits. They accuse Israel of trying to drive them out of Jerusalem.
The municipality says it approved 75 percent of 504 applications to build in Arab neighbourhoods in the past two years. It approved 90 percent of 2,893 applications to build in Jewish neighbourhoods.
This year the municipality has issued 17 orders to destroy homes in East Jerusalem and has carried out four of them.
